## Overview

`dicomtk.ai` extends `dicomtk` with `ellmer`-based clinical imaging agents, a Model Context Protocol (`MCP`) server via `mcptools`, pluggable AI segmentation backends with uncertainty maps, clinical report NLP, `RadLex` / `LOINC-RSNA` protocol harmonisation, and `DuckDB` vector similarity search.

## 1. Guardrailed 5-Stage Agent Workflow

Every de-identification workflow enforces the PS3.15 monotonic join-semilattice (`K < C < U < D < Z < X`), preventing any LLM or caller from weakening the baseline profile:

```{r}
library(dicomtk)
library(dicomtk.ai)

synth <- dicom_synthesize(modality = "CT", dims = c(16L, 16L, 4L), phi_profile = "basic")
out_dir <- tempfile("ai_vignette_out_")

plan <- ai_agent_plan(
  task = "deid_and_qc",
  path = synth[["out_dir"]],
  baseline_profile = dicom_deid_profile("ps3.15"),
  chat = ai_chat("offline")
)
dry <- ai_agent_dry_run(plan)
approved <- ai_agent_approve(dry, auto_approve = TRUE, approver = "vignette")
exec_res <- ai_agent_execute(approved, out_dir = out_dir)
ver <- ai_agent_verify(exec_res)
ver$passed
```

## 2. Protocol Harmonisation & Weak-Label Extraction

```{r}
hdrs <- tibble::tibble(
  SeriesDescription = c("CHEST WO CON 3.0mm", "BRAIN_T1_POST_GAD"),
  Modality = c("CT", "MR"),
  BodyPartExamined = c("CHEST", "HEAD")
)
ai_harmonize_protocol(hdrs)
```

## 3. Cleanup

```{r, include = FALSE}
unlink(c(synth[["out_dir"]], out_dir), recursive = TRUE)
```
